figma.provenance_note: Original eleven-screen/sixty-six-component first-pass design and validation remain preserved. Separate advanced_design records actual newly authored editable frames and connected prototypes; it does not rewrite original IDs or imply runtime release acceptance.

review_contract.private_login: pause executor and reviewer observation; revoke queued permits
review_contract.model_selection: smallest evaluated eligible model from configured providers; no new billing fallback

design_coverage_note: Original eleven core Figma screens preserve first-pass provenance. The independently verified advanced extension has 95 editable connected states, four compact layouts, four reused shared patterns and 234 stored navigation edges. The seven-family inventory maps actual runtime contracts and separate qualification gates; example Figma data executes no runtime actions.
